long_biography.plain_text:
Martyn founded Genoa Healthcare in 2002, building pharmacies inside community mental-health centers so patients could obtain medication where they received care. Under his leadership, the company expanded from its Seattle base into a multistate specialty-pharmacy network. The focused model linked dispensing with adherence support and made Genoa a distinctive operator in behavioral healthcare.

Genoa combined with QoL meds in 2014, creating a larger national platform and bringing Martyn's founding tenure to a close. He later returned to the sector through Velero Health Partners, which pursues partnerships with mental-health and addiction-service organizations. He also serves as chief executive of Florida-based Timberland Door and leads the Martyn Family Foundation, supporting mental-health treatment, education and awareness.
